signals.expression: MUL(RANK(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), ZSCORE(ADD(INDICATOR(SUB(RATIO(dp, at), MA(RATIO(dp, at), 3)), 0), ADD(INDICATOR(RATIO(SUB(che, lct), at), 0), INDICATOR(SUB(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), sale), MA(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), sale), 3)), 0)))))

signals.name: Industry Neutral Sales Anchor Count
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(sale, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), ZSCORE(ADD(INDICATOR(SUB(RATIO(dp, at), MA(RATIO(dp, at), 3)), 0), INDICATOR(RATIO(SUB(che, lct), at), 0))))

signals.name: Enterprise Anchor With Floored Denominator
signals.expression: MUL(RANK(RATIO(ebitda, MAX(ADD(MUL(prcc_f, csho), SUB(ADD(dltt, dlc), che)), MUL(prcc_f, csho)))), ZSCORE(ADD(INDICATOR(SUB(RATIO(dp, at), MA(RATIO(dp, at), 3)), 0), INDICATOR(RATIO(SUB(che, lct), at), 0))))

signals.name: Sales Anchor With Margin Hurdle
signals.expression: MUL(RANK(RATIO(sale, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), ZSCORE(ADD(INDICATOR(SUB(RATIO(dp, at), MA(RATIO(dp, at), 3)), 0), ADD(INDICATOR(RATIO(SUB(che, lct), at), 0), INDICATOR(SUB(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), sale), MA(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), sale), 3)), 0)))))

signals.name: Peer Relative Hurdle Thresholds
signals.expression: MUL(RANK(RATIO(sale, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), ZSCORE(ADD(INDICATOR(IND_ZSCORE(SUB(RATIO(dp, at), MA(RATIO(dp, at), 3))), 0), INDICATOR(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(che, lct), at)), 0))))

signals.name: Gross Profit Anchored Hurdle Count
signals.expression: MUL(RANK(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), MUL(prcc_f, csho))), ZSCORE(ADD(INDICATOR(SUB(RATIO(dp, at), MA(RATIO(dp, at), 3)), 0), INDICATOR(RATIO(SUB(che, lct), at), 0))))

signals.name: Two Year Confirmed Hurdle Count
signals.expression: MUL(RANK(RATIO(sale, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), ZSCORE(ADD(INDICATOR(MIN(SUB(RATIO(dp, at), MA(RATIO(dp, at), 3)), LAG(SUB(RATIO(dp, at), MA(RATIO(dp, at), 3)), 1)), 0), INDICATOR(MIN(RATIO(SUB(che, lct), at), LAG(RATIO(SUB(che, lct), at), 1)), 0))))

method.paper: Harvey and Liu, False (and Missed) Discoveries in Financial Economics
